stem: Which line from the play best shows that Jude is beginning to appreciate objects from the past?

options.label: A
options.text: [GRANDPA SAM gently hands JUDE the camera. JUDE examines it while GRANDPA SAM watches with a smile.]

options.label: B
options.text: GRANDPA SAM: I bet I have some old film from when I was younger back at home. I can show you sometime.

options.label: C
options.text: JUDE: Yes, please, Grandpa! I wish we could go look for it right now! [JUDE jumps up and down impatiently.]

visual_elements: Play excerpt with lines by GRANDPA SAM and JUDE, including stage directions in brackets.
